files_or_snippet: marked v15.0.12 ESM build (lib/marked.esm.js), whole file; repo https://github.com/markedjs/marked found via GitHub repository search in the browser
how_adapted: Copied whole file through the GUI browser (select all, copy, paste). Patched: escape regexes/table no longer escape the apostrophe; block html() and inline tag() tokenizers return nothing, so raw HTML falls through as escaped text; 'html' alternatives removed from paragraph, table, setext-heading and list-item interruption regexes; GFM task-list detection and bare-URL (url) autolinks disabled. src/markdown.js adds renderer overrides (CommonMark-style hr/br/img/code output, entity decoding, URL scheme sanitisation, percent-encoding), heading-id/TOC/slugify glue; src/cli.js is new glue code.
